rollups.text: The user was writing *The African Motivator*, a book using lions to explore family bonds, territorial protection, leadership, and human life. By 2023-05-20, Chapter 1, “Awaken the lion in you,” had seven sections: “It starts with you,” “What do I really stand for?,” “How Deep are my roots?,” “Resourcefulness,” “Acting Proactively,” “Practice what you preach,” and “Intrinsic Motivators.” The user requested an outline and expanded introduction; the proposed introduction framed the lion as a symbol of strength, courage, and leadership and previewed the seven sections. The project was still being developed as of the latest related record, 2023-05-20.

The user was planning a sustainable e-commerce store focused on eco-friendly home goods for a mainly national customer base. The user attended a helpful online-business seminar on 2023-04-15, then discussed store assumptions and operations on 2023-05-25: estimated average order value about $50, typical order weight 2–3 pounds, possible free shipping above $75, and USPS Priority Mail as an option to investigate. The user also planned to research returns-management and customer-service software, designate a team for inquiries, create a knowledge base, decide which success metrics to track, and develop a content-marketing strategy. No store launch was confirmed.

The user said they were moving to Toronto in six weeks on 2023-05-27, after fleeing persecution and violence about two years earlier. The user had received support from UNHCR and the Canadian government and waited more than a year for asylum approval. They were taking English classes, had contacted settlement agencies, and had explored City of Toronto and Toronto Public Library resources; they had heard of YMCA services but had not yet checked them. The user hoped to work in social work, improve English, volunteer to gain Canadian experience, build a network, explore Toronto, and find belonging. They were excited but nervous and concerned about job competition, credential recognition, work culture, and costs. The stated move date, six weeks after 2023-05-27, conflicts with the record’s approximate parenthetical date of 2023-06-08; no move completion was recorded.

The user was considering proposing to their partner, Mike, on 2023-05-27. Mike prefers simple, classic designs and dislikes flashy styles; the user thought a solitaire ring would suit him. The user favored a private garden picnic with the user’s parents present, planned to invite Mike casually, prepare his favorite foods and drinks, arrange a romantic surprise with meaningful details, and speak sincerely. The user drew inspiration from their parents, who celebrated their 30th wedding anniversary in April 2023. The proposal was a plan under consideration, not a confirmed event.

The user asked about triathlon nutrition, complex carbohydrates during the bike segment, bike fit and aerodynamics, and balancing training with other commitments. The user planned to improve swimming technique with drills and exercises and was considering bike-setup changes. No triathlon participation was confirmed.

On 2023-05-27, the user also reported difficulty getting portrait subjects’ eyes sharp, mostly using manual focus after autofocus problems with an old 18–55mm kit lens; the user planned to try focus peaking and Live View. The user used a Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW and was considering a Peak Design Everyday Sling 5L; earlier they were comparing the Lowepro ProTactic 450 AW with a Think Tank Urban Disguise 40L. During the break, the user noticed comparing their life with others on social media and feeling inadequate. The user wanted to build self-confidence and self-worth without relying on social-media validation, and to practice self-compassion and focus on their own life and story. The user was especially interested in vulnerability and shame and in Brené Brown’s work, including *Daring Greatly*; *Rising Strong* was recommended, but the user did not confirm reading or acquiring it.
